description: This source file defines the 'AppState' class, which manages the application's state, preferences, and configuration synchronization. It includes properties for user settings, connection modes, remote gateway configuration, wake word settings, and lifecycle management such as initializing configuration watchers and applying configuration overrides. Additionally, it handles persistence via UserDefaults, communicates with system components, and provides mechanisms for updating remote configurations dynamically.

classes.name: AppState
classes.description: Represents the centralized application state, handling user preferences, configuration details, remote gateway settings, voice wake configurations, and various flags affecting app behavior. It ensures persistence, synchronization, and reactive updates, serving as the core state object for the app.
